Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Illustrator Rovina Cai brings her haunting and poetic vision back to Magic for an Artist Series drop unlike any we’ve ever seen. Inspired by the mystic symbolism of tarot cards, Rovina’s ethereal art casts a charming spell on any who see it. Good fortune is sure to follow those lucky enough to acquire this drop.
Contents:
• 1x Rainbow Foil Inalla, Archmage Ritualist
• 1x Rainbow Foil Aether Vial
• 1x Rainbow Foil Arcane Signet
• 1x Rainbow Foil Sword of the Animist
